name: Coordinated Cavalry (Combat, Teamwork)
body:
Your hoof-beats snap into form and your line charges as one.

Prerequisite(s): Mounted Combat

Benefit(s): When you begin your turn adjacent to an ally that also has this feat and both of you are mounted you gain a +2 bonus to the first attack roll you make after your mount moves this turn. If an ally with this feat has previously moved and attacked a creature you attack this turn, you gain a +4 bonus to your first damage roll against that creature this turn.
